model_annotation: Figure 3(a) displays the F1 score curves for three different frameworks—Teacher, Self-Training, and PST—under Scheme One, as the label loss rate varies. The x-axis is labeled “漏标率” (label loss rate), ranging from 0 to 0.585 with a linear scale and uniform tick intervals of 0.1, though the last tick is labeled 0.585. The y-axis is labeled “F1值” (F1 score), ranging from 52.5 to 72.5 with a linear scale and uniform tick intervals of 2.5. The red dashed line with circular markers represents the Teacher framework, starting at approximately 72.5 when the label loss rate is 0 and decreasing to about 53.0 at a label loss rate of 0.585. The blue dash-dotted line with square markers represents the Self-Training framework, beginning at approximately 70.5 at a label loss rate of 0 and declining to about 53.0 at 0.585. The green solid line with triangular markers represents the PST framework, starting at approximately 71.0 at a label loss rate of 0 and decreasing to approximately 59.0 at 0.585. All three lines show a downward trend as the label loss rate increases, with the PST framework maintaining a higher F1 score than the other two across the entire range.
